subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw retroactively publish signed/notarized macOS beta assets and `appcast-beta.xml` for v2026.5.22-beta.1, or formally leave that beta without desktop assets under the current beta policy?
rationale: The current source state and live release state prove the request is still unmet, but completing it requires maintainer-held release credentials and a product/release policy choice because docs currently permit beta releases without macOS app assets.

options.title: Hold for paired PR decision
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker while release owners decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 should land, be narrowed, or be closed.

options.title: Adopt signed beta desktop distribution
options.body: Land or replace the paired PR, run private macOS publish for the beta, upload signed assets, and publish a valid beta appcast.

options.title: Declare this beta CLI/npm-only
options.body: Record that v2026.5.22-beta.1 will not ship desktop assets, then close this issue and the paired PR with the release-policy rationale.

recommendation.title: Hold for paired PR decision
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker while release owners decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 should land, be narrowed, or be closed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate for the release-policy choice based on repeated appcast and release-publication history.
